    "source": "{\"cells\":[{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"dd9b7bbf\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"# robust-edit: reliable file edits for the Gemma 4 agent harness (31B A/B)\\n\\n**robust-edit** is a drop-in skill (dataset: `magicsword001/robust-edit`, Apache 2.0) that removes editing failures\\ncaused by the harness rather than by the model:\\n\\n- `edit_file` often fails on 31B: a string argument gets closed with a backtick and the other arguments are lost,\\n  or `old_string` does not match.\\n- Tool results reach the model as JSON, so code shows `\\\\n` and `\\\\\\\"`; models copy these escapes into\\n  `old_string`, and `edit_file`'s fallback does not undo a backslash followed by a real line break.\\n- After a failed edit the model tends to repeat the identical call.\\n- The harness's reset of agent-edited test files is a no-op in swegemma 0.2.7, so one edited test file makes the\\n  hidden test patch fail to apply.\\n\\nA one-call setup step installs a small editor into `.git/agent/edit.py` and keeps test-file edits out of the patch.\\nThe agent then edits with one `run_command` (SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in a heredoc); the editor undoes copied escapes,\\nnever writes a Python file that does not compile, and answers a miss with the closest lines.\\n\\nThis notebook (1) demonstrates the editor on a toy repository (no GPU needed), then (2) runs Gemma 4 31B on 4×L4\\nwith two agents that are identical except for robust-edit, alternately on the same training tasks, and counts\\nediting outcomes. Traces, patches and logs are deleted at the end; only the counts are kept.\\n\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"661e17db\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 1. The editor on a toy repository (no GPU)\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"fb1ee1d2\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"import glob, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\nSKILL_DIR = next(Path(p).parent for p in sorted(glob.glob('/kaggle/input/**/skills/robust-edit/SKILL.md', recursive=True))\\n                 if (Path(p).parents[2] / 'README.md').is_file() and (Path(p).parents[2] / 'example').is_dir())\\nEXAMPLE_DIR = SKILL_DIR.parents[1] / 'example'\\nprint('skill:', SKILL_DIR)\\n\\n# A toy repository with the editor installed the way setup.py does it\\ndemo = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())\\n(demo / 'pkg').mkdir()\\n(demo / 'pkg' / 'mod.py').write_text('def greet(name):\\\\n    if not name:\\\\n        return \\\"\\\"\\\\n    return f\\\"hi {name}\\\"\\\\n')\\nsubprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q'], cwd=demo, check=True)\\n(demo / '.git' / 'agent').mkdir()\\nshutil.copyfile(SKILL_DIR / 'scripts' / 'edit_tool.py', demo / '.git' / 'agent' / 'edit.py')\\n\\n\\ndef edit(args, stdin=''):\\n    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '.git/agent/edit.py', *args], cwd=demo, input=stdin,\\n                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\\n    print(f'$ python3 .git/agent/edit.py {\\\" \\\".join(args)}\\\\n{out}')\\n\\n\\nblock = lambda s, r: f'\u003c\u003c\u003c\u003c\u003c\u003c\u003c SEARCH\\\\n{s}\\\\n=======\\\\n{r}\\\\n\u003e\u003e\u003e\u003e\u003e\u003e\u003e REPLACE\\\\n'\\n# 1. SEARCH copied with JSON escapes from a tool result (backslash + line break, \\\\\\\")\\nedit(['pkg/mod.py'], block('    if not name:\\\\\\\\\\\\n        return \\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\"', '    if not name:\\\\\\\\\\\\n        return \\\"nobody\\\"'))\\n# 2. An edit that would break the syntax is refused\\nedit(['pkg/mod.py'], block('    if not name:', '    if not name'))\\n# 3. SEARCH that is not in the file: the closest lines come back with line numbers\\nedit(['pkg/mod.py'], block('    return f\\\"hello {name}\\\"', '    return f\\\"hello, {name}\\\"'))\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"49cdcfa0\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 2. Install the harness (offline wheelhouse)\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"c1995d09\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"import glob, importlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\nos.environ['LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP'] = 'True'\\nos.environ['TRANSFORMERS_NO_TF'] = '1'\\nos.environ['VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD'] = 'spawn'\\nos.environ['VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS'] = '1'\\nos.environ['VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S'] = '1200'\\nos.environ['VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS'] = '1'\\nos.environ['OTEL_SDK_DISABLED'] = 'true'\\nos.environ['PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF'] = 'expandable_segments:True'\\n\\nWHEELHOUSE_DIR = Path('/kaggle/input/datasets/metric/gemma-4-developer-agent-wheelhouse')\\nfor pth_pattern in ('/usr/local/lib/python*/dist-packages/*cutlass*.pth', '/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/*cutlass*.pth'):\\n    for pth in glob.glob(pth_pattern):\\n        try:\\n            os.unlink(pth)\\n        except OSError:\\n            pass\\ntmp_whl = Path('/tmp/wheelhouse')\\ntmp_whl.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\nfor w in WHEELHOUSE_DIR.glob('*.whl'):\\n    if 'cutlass' in w.name.lower():\\n        continue\\n    target = tmp_whl / (w.name.replace('cu128', '+cu128') if ('cu128' in w.name and '+' not in w.name) else w.name)\\n    if not target.exists():\\n        os.symlink(w, target)\\nwheels = sorted(str(w) for w in tmp_whl.glob('*.whl'))\\nsubprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '-q', '--no-deps', '--force-reinstall', *wheels], check=True)\\nimportlib.invalidate_caches()\\nprint(f'Installed {len(wheels)} wheels')\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"11ee2932\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 3. Two agents that differ only in robust-edit\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"8a922073\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"from swegemma.models import load_tasks\\n\\nDATA_DIR = Path('/kaggle/input/competitions/gemma-4-developer-agent')\\nWORKING_DIR = Path('/kaggle/working')\\n\\n# robust_edit: the example submission shipped with the dataset (a setup step, then the solver).\\n# baseline: the same solver prompt with edit_file in step 4 and no \\\"Editing files\\\" section, a single agent, no skill.\\nARM_DIRS = {}\\nd = WORKING_DIR / 'agents' / 'robust_edit'\\nshutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)\\nshutil.copytree(EXAMPLE_DIR, d)\\nARM_DIRS['robust_edit'] = d\\n\\nd = WORKING_DIR / 'agents' / 'baseline'\\nshutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)\\n(d / 'prompts').mkdir(parents=True)\\nshutil.copytree(EXAMPLE_DIR / 'configs', d / 'configs')\\nshutil.copyfile(EXAMPLE_DIR / 'eval_config.yaml', d / 'eval_config.yaml')\\n# baseline prompt: step 4 says edit_file instead of the editor, and the \\\"Editing files\\\" section is dropped\\nsolver = (EXAMPLE_DIR / 'prompts' / 'solver.md').read_text()\\ns4, s5 = solver.index('4. '), solver.index('5. ')\\nsolver = (solver[:s4] + '4. Make the smallest change that fixes it. Edit files with `edit_file`; create new files '\\n          'with `write_file`.\\\\n' + solver[s5:])\\nstart, end = solver.index('## Editing files'), solver.index('## Notes')\\n(d / 'prompts' / 'solver.md').write_text(solver[:start] + solver[end:])\\n(d / 'agent.yaml').write_text('''name: swe_agent\\nmodel: gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct\\ninstruction: !include prompts/solver.md\\ntools: [run_command, submit_patch, get_status, read_file, edit_file, write_file,\\n        get_code_neighbors, search_similar_code, get_code_subgraph]\\ngenerate_content_config: !include configs/sampling.yaml\\n''')\\nARM_DIRS['baseline'] = d\\nARM_DIRS = {k: ARM_DIRS[k] for k in ('baseline', 'robust_edit')}\\n\\nTASK_IDS = [\\\"fastapi_14786\\\", \\\"requests_7315\\\", \\\"rich_3454\\\", \\\"rich_3894\\\", \\\"fastapi_14479\\\", \\\"fastapi_14458\\\", \\\"requests_7427\\\", \\\"rich_3470\\\", \\\"fastapi_14360\\\", \\\"fastapi_14485\\\", \\\"fastapi_13713\\\", \\\"rich_3061\\\", \\\"rich_3518\\\", \\\"rich_3905\\\", \\\"requests_7505\\\", \\\"requests_7205\\\"]\\nTASKS_PATH = DATA_DIR / 'tasks.jsonl'\\nall_tasks = {t.instance_id: t for t in load_tasks(TASKS_PATH)}\\nSAMPLE_TASKS = [all_tasks[i] for i in TASK_IDS]\\nprint(f'{len(SAMPLE_TASKS)} tasks x {len(ARM_DIRS)} configurations')\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"af7d7b79\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 4. Start vLLM (31B, tensor parallel over 4×L4)\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"82dff64d\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"import litellm\\nimport torch\\nfrom adk_submission import VllmConfig, VllmServer, discover_adapters\\nfrom swegemma.config import ALLOWED_ADAPTER_EXTENSIONS\\nfrom swegemma.models.discovery import validate_single_declared_model\\n\\nlitellm.drop_params = True\\nTARGET_MODEL_NAME = 'gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct'\\nMODEL_PATH = Path('/kaggle/input/models/google/gemma-4/other/gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct/2')\\n\\nfirst_dir = next(iter(ARM_DIRS.values()))\\ndeclared_model = validate_single_declared_model(first_dir)\\nadapters = discover_adapters(str(first_dir), adapter_extensions=ALLOWED_ADAPTER_EXTENSIONS)\\ngpu_count = torch.cuda.device_count() if torch.cuda.is_available() else 1\\ntp_size = 4 if gpu_count \u003e= 4 else (2 if gpu_count \u003e= 2 else 1)\\nvllm_cfg = VllmConfig(\\n    model=str(MODEL_PATH), port=8000, host='127.0.0.1',\\n    tool_call_parser='gemma4', reasoning_parser='gemma4', max_model_len=32768,\\n    dtype='bfloat16' if (torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported()) else 'auto',\\n    gpu_memory_utilization=0.90, enable_auto_tool_choice=True,\\n    enable_lora=True, max_loras=8, max_lora_rank=128,\\n    tensor_parallel_size=tp_size, startup_timeout=60 * 20,\\n)\\nserver_instance = VllmServer(vllm_cfg, adapter_manifest=adapters)\\nserver_instance.start()\\nprint(f'vLLM server started on {server_instance.base_url} (tp={tp_size}, gpus={gpu_count})')\\nmodels = server_instance.create_model_registry(\\n    aliases=[declared_model, TARGET_MODEL_NAME], model_prefix='openai/', api_key='EMPTY')\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"9e2b1b4f\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 5. Run both agents (40 tool calls / 20 min per task)\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"7c187efb\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"import asyncio, concurrent.futures, time\\nimport pandas as pd\\nfrom google.adk.agents.context_cache_config import ContextCacheConfig\\nfrom google.adk.apps._configs import EventsCompactionConfig\\nfrom swegemma.config import EvalConfig, build_submission_limits\\nfrom swegemma.evaluate import Evaluator\\n\\n\\ndef run_sync(coro_or_fn, *args, **kwargs):\\n    fn = (lambda: coro_or_fn(*args, **kwargs)) if callable(coro_or_fn) else (lambda: coro_or_fn)\\n    try:\\n        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\\n    except RuntimeError:\\n        loop = None\\n    if loop is not None and loop.is_running():\\n        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:\\n            return pool.submit(lambda: asyncio.run(fn())).result()\\n    return asyncio.run(fn())\\n\\n\\nlimits, gen_constraints = build_submission_limits()\\nevaluators = {}\\nfor arm, agent_dir in ARM_DIRS.items():\\n    evaluators[arm] = Evaluator(EvalConfig(\\n        tasks_path=TASKS_PATH, snapshots_dir=DATA_DIR / 'snapshots', results_dir=WORKING_DIR / 'results' / arm,\\n        submission_dir=agent_dir, models=models, sandbox='subprocess',\\n        timeout_seconds=300, max_time_minutes=20, max_tool_calls=40, max_turns=500,\\n        limits=limits, generation_constraints=gen_constraints, adapter_manifest=adapters,\\n        context_cache_config=ContextCacheConfig(min_tokens=2048, ttl_seconds=1800, cache_intervals=10),\\n        events_compaction_config=EventsCompactionConfig(\\n            compaction_interval=15, overlap_size=2, token_threshold=14336, event_retention_size=5),\\n        graph_dir=str(DATA_DIR / 'graphs'), embeddings_dir=str(DATA_DIR / 'embeddings'),\\n        wheels_dir=DATA_DIR / 'wheels', verbose=False,\\n    ))\\n\\n# Alternate the order per task so neither configuration always runs first\\nrows = []\\narm_names = list(ARM_DIRS)\\nfor idx, task in enumerate(SAMPLE_TASKS, start=1):\\n    order = arm_names if idx % 2 else arm_names[::-1]\\n    for arm in order:\\n        t0 = time.time()\\n        try:\\n            result = run_sync(evaluators[arm].evaluate_task, task=task, task_index=idx, total_tasks=len(SAMPLE_TASKS))\\n            rows.append({'arm': arm, 'task': task.instance_id, 'resolved': bool(result.resolved),\\n                         'tool_calls': result.tool_calls, 'patch_chars': len(result.agent_patch or ''),\\n                         'error': (result.error or '')[:80], 'seconds': round(result.duration_seconds)})\\n        except Exception as e:  # keep going so one broken task does not lose the whole run\\n            rows.append({'arm': arm, 'task': task.instance_id, 'resolved': False,\\n                         'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'[:120], 'seconds': round(time.time() - t0)})\\n        print(rows[-1], flush=True)\\n        pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(WORKING_DIR / 'task_results.csv', index=False)\\nresults_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)\\nresults_df.pivot_table(index='task', columns='arm', values='resolved', aggfunc='first')\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"f869e39f\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 6. Editing outcomes per agent\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"05be5e77\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"import re\\nfrom collections import Counter\\n\\n\\ndef edit_stats(trace_path):\\n    c = Counter()\\n    prev, streak = None, 0\\n    for step in json.loads(trace_path.read_text())['steps']:\\n        obs = (step.get('observation') or {}).get('content', '') or ''\\n        for call in step.get('tool_calls') or []:\\n            name, args = call['function_name'], call.get('arguments') or {}\\n            sig = json.dumps([name, args], sort_keys=True)\\n            streak = streak + 1 if sig == prev else 1\\n            prev = sig\\n            c['max identical calls in a row'] = max(c['max identical calls in a row'], streak)\\n            c['tool calls'] += 1\\n            if 'mandatory input parameters are not present' in obs:\\n                c['calls with lost arguments'] += 1\\n            if name == 'run_skill_script':\\n                c['setup ok'] += int('Tests protected' in obs or 'PROTECTED' in obs)\\n                c['setup by setup step'] += int(call.get('extra', {}).get('author') == 'setup')\\n            if name == 'edit_file':\\n                c['edit_file'] += 1\\n                if 'mandatory input parameters are not present' in obs:\\n                    c['edit_file: arguments lost'] += 1\\n                elif '\\\"status\\\": \\\"error\\\"' in obs:\\n                    c['edit_file: failed'] += 1\\n                else:\\n                    c['edit_file: ok'] += 1\\n            if name == 'run_command' and '.git/agent/edit.py' in (args.get('command') or ''):\\n                cmd = args.get('command') or ''\\n                if '--show' in cmd:\\n                    c['editor: --show'] += 1\\n                    continue\\n                c['editor edits'] += 1\\n                if 'APPLIED to' in obs and 'NOT APPLIED' not in obs:\\n                    c['editor: applied'] += 1\\n                    c['editor: applied after repair'] += int('(matched:' in obs)\\n                else:\\n                    c['editor: not applied'] += 1\\n    return c\\n\\n\\nper_arm, per_task = {}, []\\nfor arm in ARM_DIRS:\\n    total = Counter()\\n    for path in sorted((WORKING_DIR / 'results' / arm / 'traces').glob('trace_*.json')):\\n        s = edit_stats(path)\\n        per_task.append({'arm': arm, 'task': path.stem.removeprefix('trace_'), **s})\\n        total.update({k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'max identical calls in a row'})\\n        total['worst identical streak'] = max(total['worst identical streak'], s['max identical calls in a row'])\\n    sub = results_df[results_df.arm == arm]\\n    total['tasks'] = len(sub)\\n    total['resolved'] = int(sub.resolved.sum())\\n    per_arm[arm] = total\\n\\nsummary = pd.DataFrame(per_arm).fillna(0).astype(int)\\ndisplay(summary)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(per_task).fillna(0))\\n(WORKING_DIR / 'ab_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'per_arm': per_arm, 'per_task': per_task}, indent=1, default=int))\"},{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"id\":\"6d3ed66f\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"## 7. Clean up (keep only the counts)\"},{\"cell_type\":\"code\",\"execution_count\":null,\"id\":\"13ade808\",\"metadata\":{},\"outputs\":[],\"source\":\"# Do not redistribute competition data: drop traces, patches, logs and test outputs; keep only the counts.\\nfor arm in ARM_DIRS:\\n    shutil.rmtree(WORKING_DIR / 'results' / arm, ignore_errors=True)\\nshutil.rmtree(WORKING_DIR / 'agents', ignore_errors=True)\\nprint(sorted(p.name for p in WORKING_DIR.iterdir()))\"}],\"metadata\":{\"kernelspec\":{\"display_name\":\"Python 3\",\"language\":\"python\",\"name\":\"python3\"}},\"nbformat\":4,\"nbformat_minor\":5}",
